title: Keep regular visitors signed in
description: A session used in its last 7 days is extended to 30 days again, so customers who visit every week are not signed out. Includes tests and a README note.

comments.issue: 7 * 24 * 60 * 1000 ms is about 2.8 hours, not 7 days (a factor of 60 is missing), so sessions are only extended in their last few hours and weekly visitors are still signed out.
